scripts.text: If everyone is like you, I'm going to be unemployed!! Haha~!
scripts.translation: 人人都像你這樣愛惜裝備，我可就要失業了！！哈哈~！

scripts.text: Each repair costs {0} Zeny. So to repair all your damaged items would cost {1} Zeny! Would you like to repair the items?
scripts.translation: 每件修理需要{0} Zeny，修理全部損壞的物品需要{1} Zeny！要修理嗎？

scripts.text: Check your wallet before you receive the repair bill! I can't repair anything because you don't have enough Zeny.
scripts.translation: 先看看錢包吧！你的Zeny不足，沒法修理。

scripts.text: Okay! All done. Now, try to be a little more careful. Items have lives too you know.
scripts.translation: 好了！全部修好了。現在請多加小心，物品也是有壽命的。

scripts.text: Mmm? Something's wrong. Wait... Equip the items you need to repair and then come back to me.
scripts.translation: 嗯？有點不對勁。等等...請裝備你需要修復的物品，然後再回來找我。

scripts.text: Well, it's no skin off my nose, but it's not good to leave items damaged. You should get them repaired as soon as possible!
scripts.translation: 好吧，雖然對我來說沒什麼大不了的，但讓物品保持損壞狀態是不好的。你應該儘快去修復它們！
我們就沒什麼生意可談了，
因為你沒有需要修理的物品。
